Among20 forward cases A had Robot contact in1case and contact-plus25mm-lift in0cases. Only5 reverse cases achieved ordered firstpan;3 achieved firstcup ownpad; afterward C had Robot contact in1of3cases and25mm-lift in0of3cases. This localizes observed failures to firstcup selection/acquisition and progression to another cup, not a whole-success scoring-only problem.
